items.summary: Super Rare／Electronic Sheep《Lelu》將喺 2027 年 1 月 21 日登陸 Xbox Series、Switch 2 同 Steam：黑白風 Metroidvania，扮演獲得意識嘅發條玩具逃離玩具工廠。
items.note: publishedAt from EDT Oct 15 afternoon.
items.imageAlt: Lelu release date key art

items.title: Cult of the Lamb Switch 2 edition dated October 22 with free upgrade
items.summary: Massive Monster 宣布《Cult of the Lamb》Switch 2 版將喺 10 月 22 日推出，售價 $24.99；現有 Switch 玩家可免費升級，未公布解析度或幀率等強化細節。
items.note: publishedAt date-only from Siliconera Oct 16.
items.imageAlt: Cult of the Lamb Switch 2 announcement screenshot

items.title: Modern Warfare 4 DMZ Early Access starts October 20
items.summary: 數碼預購／預購《Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4》嘅玩家，可由 10 月 20 日起搶先玩完整 DMZ；涵蓋 Xbox、PS5、Battle.net、Steam 同 Switch 2。戰役 Early Access 已於 10 月 16 日開始。
items.note: Campaign EA already covered Oct 16; this is DMZ EA angle. publishedAt date-only from article day.
items.imageAlt: Modern Warfare 4 DMZ Forward Operating Base art

items.title: Nintendo details Switch Sports Resort sports ahead of October 22
items.summary: 任天堂喺官網介紹《Nintendo Switch Sports Resort》12 項運動（含新作手指摔角、滑板），Switch 2 獨佔，10 月 22 日發售；可單人、本地或線上對戰。
items.note: Countdown feature; launch date previously known. publishedAt date-only from Nintendo post date 10/16/26.

items.title: Monster Hunter Wilds Switch 2 Prologue Demo launches October 19
items.summary: Capcom《Monster Hunter Wilds》Switch 2 免費序章 demo 將喺 10 月 19 日推出，支援本地多人；存檔可帶入 12 月 4 日正式版，demo 期間唔設線上多人。
items.note: publishedAt from EDT late Oct 14. Full Switch 2 game Dec 4.
items.imageAlt: Monster Hunter Wilds Switch 2 prologue demo art

items.title: Lightyear Frontier 1.0 set for November 4 with save carry-over
items.summary: FRAME BREAK《Lightyear Frontier》將喺 11 月 4 日離開 Early Access 推 1.0：新結局、兩個新地區、自動化同機甲升級；現有存檔可沿用。平台包括 Steam 同 Xbox Series。
items.note: Studio post dated 29 Sep; still circulating in Oct 17 weekend digests. publishedAt date-only from site.
items.imageAlt: Lightyear Frontier 1.0 cover art

items.title: HorrorVale: Deadluxe Edition dated October 31 for consoles and Switch
items.summary: Electric Airship／BatWorks《HorrorVale: Deadluxe Edition》將喺 10 月 31 日登陸 PS5、Xbox Series、PS4、Xbox One 同 Switch；PC 版早於 2024 年推出，主機版含戰鬥同 QOL 強化。
items.note: publishedAt from EDT.
items.imageAlt: HorrorVale Deadluxe Edition console key art

items.title: Blood of Dawnwalker Update 1.1 brings respec and petting next week
items.summary: Rebel Wolves 宣布《The Blood of Dawnwalker》Update 1.1 計劃下週推出：含技能重置藥水、方向性摸寵、新 Story 難度、字幕同 FrameGen 改善，以及超過一千項修正；日本 Steam 版將解除血腥審查。
items.note: Exact day next week not stated; window includes week of Oct 19. publishedAt from PDT article timestamp.
items.imageAlt: The Blood of Dawnwalker gameplay screenshot

items.title: Brave Dungeon + Dark Witch's Story: COMBAT coming to PS5 October 24
items.summary: Inside System 將喺 10 月 24 日喺 PS5 推出地牢 RPG 合輯《Brave Dungeon + Dark Witch's Story: COMBAT》；組合早前已有 Switch 同 Steam 版，現可喺 PlayStation Store 加入願望清單。
items.note: publishedAt from EDT late Oct 15.
items.imageAlt: Brave Dungeon Dark Witch COMBAT PS5 art

items.title: Guns of Eschaton mystical Western Soulslike FPS dated December 8
items.summary: 4Divinity／Eschatology《Guns of Eschaton》將喺 12 月 8 日登陸 PS5、Xbox Series 同 Steam：融合精準射擊同 Soulslike 節奏嘅末世西部，藝術總監含 Viktor Antonov，支援單人同合作。
items.note: publishedAt from EDT Oct 15.
items.imageAlt: Guns of Eschaton key art

items.title: The Killing Stone leaves Early Access October 21 multiplatform
items.summary: Question《The Killing Stone》將喺 10 月 21 日結束 Early Access，登陸 PS5、Xbox Series 同 PC（Steam／Epic／Microsoft Store），售價 $19.99；1.0 加入最終章同更多劇情選項同配音。
items.note: Dating news from Oct 14 still relevant ahead of launch. publishedAt from EDT.
items.imageAlt: The Killing Stone 1.0 release art

items.title: Deadlock hits 303,347 concurrent Steam players while invite-only
items.summary: Valve《Deadlock》喺推出新英雄 Violet 同 City Never Sleeps 更新後，併發人數達 303,347，仍屬邀請制封閉測試，一度躋身 Steam 最多人玩榜前四。
items.note: publishedAt from Destructoid Oct 17 12:57 pm (assumed local US) converted approx to HKT morning Oct 18; peak per SteamDB cited in article.
items.imageAlt: Deadlock character screenshot

items.title: US Rep. Torres proposes Power To The Players Act for game ownership
items.summary: 紐約民主黨議員 Ritchie Torres 提出《Power To The Players Act》，要求 FTC 確保買遊戲係擁有權而非可撤銷授權，並要求原本僅線上嘅遊戲提供離線遊玩方案；全文未公開，立法仍有長路。
items.note: Bill text not fully public yet; outcome uncertain. publishedAt from Ars Oct 16 3:41 pm ET approx → HKT Oct 17.
items.imageAlt: Rep. Ritchie Torres headshot

items.title: Liquid Swords, studio behind Samson, goes bankrupt
items.summary: 瑞典工作室 Liquid Swords（前 Avalanche 共同創辦人 Christofer Sundberg）被斯德哥爾摩地方法院裁定破產，影響近 30 名員工；《Samson》資產已開標至 10 月 21 日，後續更新未定。
items.note: Court order reported Oct 12; Kotaku story Oct 17. publishedAt date-only.
items.imageAlt: Samson game key art

items.title: Analogue Super Nt Plus and Mega Sg Plus open pre-orders October 19
items.summary: Analogue 重推 FPGA 復古主機 Super Nt+ 同 Mega Sg+：加入 USB-C／USB-A、內建藍牙或 2.4GHz 無線手掣、可熱插拔卡帶；10 月 19 日太平洋時間上午 9 時起預購，每部 $219.99，預計 12 月出貨。
items.note: publishedAt from UTC article time.
items.imageAlt: Analogue Super Nt Plus and Mega Sg Plus consoles

items.title: Order of the Sinking Star first-week Steam sales beat The Witness
items.summary: Thekla／Arc Games 表示《Order of the Sinking Star》首週 Steam 銷量比《The Witness》同期高 45%，峰值併發亦高約 33%，評價「Overwhelmingly Positive」；未公布絕對銷量數字。
items.note: Relative sales only; absolute figures not disclosed. Date approx from weekend digest coverage.
items.imageAlt: Order of the Sinking Star Steam news image

items.title: Bulkhead apologizes for WARDOGS Season 2 Blue bonus and Driver exploit
items.summary: Bulkhead 承認 Season 2 藍隊現金／XP 加成同 Driver 進度漏洞「搞砸咗」：已移除藍隊加成、修補漏洞，嚴重濫用者將被禁 24 小時，中期更新計劃加入限制裝備嘅 Limited Mode 伺服器。
items.note: publishedAt date-only from article day Oct 16.
items.imageAlt: WARDOGS Season 2 apology coverage image

items.title: WoW: Forever stress test moved to October 21
items.summary: Blizzard 將《World of Warcraft: Forever》壓力測試改期至 10 月 21 日（北美下午 2 時 PDT）；任何有帳號嘅玩家都可參加，唔使訂閱或 beta。測試角色之後會被清除，10 月 27 日開放名稱預約。
items.note: Update posted Oct 16; publishedAt date-only.
items.imageAlt: World of Warcraft social sharing thumbnail

items.title: Pokémon TCG Pocket slows pack cycle to roughly six weeks
items.summary: 寶可夢公司／DeNA 喺十月製作人信公布：新系列（Series C）將 booster 週期由約四週改為約六週，並加入任務取得 Immersive 卡、Special Pack、社群牌組同無限租借牌組等更新。
items.note: Letter dated Oct 15; widely covered Oct 16–17. publishedAt date-only.
items.imageAlt: Pokémon TCG Pocket October 2026 producer letter art
